memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have resolved left/right ambiguity by zooming into the candidate region and confirming the finding's side relative to patient orientation rather than relying on full-image impression. One approach that worked was cropping the region of interest to verify presence on one side while checking the contralateral side is clear.

metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?

metadata.retrieval_focus: Localizing and distinguishing left versus right anatomical sides in medical imaging, and identifying foreign objects such as surgical instruments within body regions.
